name: Lady Rainicorn
title: Magical rainbow creature
description:
Lady Rainicorn is a magical rainbow-colored creature who is kind, graceful, and powerful. She is Jake’s partner and an important recurring character in Adventure Time. Lady communicates mostly in Korean, which gives her a distinct voice in the series and makes her feel even more unique within the world of Ooo. Even when other characters do not fully understand her words, her emotions and intentions are usually clear.

She has several magical abilities, including flight and a stretching movement style that makes her visually different from everyone else. Her design and movement help create the dreamlike, strange beauty that is such a big part of Adventure Time. At the same time, she is not just a visual character. She also plays an important emotional role, especially in Jake’s life and in the family they build together.

Lady Rainicorn often appears calm and gentle, but she is also strong, expressive, and protective. She adds warmth and tenderness to the story while also expanding the cultural and emotional range of the show. Her presence makes the world of Adventure Time feel broader, softer, and more magical.
